maya: Quick follow-up from the INC-5423 postmortem — we need a compact triage cheatsheet and a clear handoff path for recurrent eviction-style incidents. Objectives: short checklist for page/on-call, canonical commands for evidence collection, escalation matrix (severity levels + PD routing), and a quarterly maintenance audit owner. Please claim items + ETA.
sanjay: I can author the cheatsheet and canonical cmds. Will keep it to 1 page and include expected outputs. ETA: 2026-03-29.
tess: I'll validate commands in staging and add brief validation notes (what to look for after running).
ev an: I'll draft the escalation matrix and PagerDuty routing rules. Proposal: Sev2 if recurrence pattern hits 3 times in 24h; Sev1 only if user-facing latency > 250ms and >10% request error increase. ETA: 2026-03-30.
ops-bot: Created INF-9010 and linked to the postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INF-9010 (cheatsheet + escalation + audit owner).
noah: I'll take the quarterly audit owner task and set up an OWNERS rotation. 90-day cadence sounds reasonable. ETA: 2026-04-05 for owners file update.
sanjay: Draft cheatsheet (to land in runbooks/cheatsheets/kv-ops.txt):
- find evidence: kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=20m | egrep -i "evict|kv_cache|cache pressure"
- pod id: POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
- collect metrics snapshot: curl -sS http://$POD:9090/metrics | egrep '\\bkv_cache_entries\\b|p99' > /tmp/metrics-snapshot.txt
- safe mitigation (staging first): curl -sS http://$POD:9090/debug/cache/evict -o /tmp/evict.json && jq . /tmp/evict.json
- quick smoke: monitor 5m for >1% 5xx or CPU >90% -> rollback steps noted below
Expected evict output: {"status":"ok", "evicted": <number>} and kv_cache_entries drop >=10% within 2m.
tess: I'll run that flow on staging tomorrow and paste results. Also suggest adding an output example in the cheatsheet so on-call can spot failures quickly.
ev an: Escalation matrix draft:
- Sev3 (informational): single eviction event, no latency change 
- Sev2 (operational): recurrence pattern (>=3 events in 24h) OR p99 delta >150ms for 10m -> page infra-oncall, create INF ticket auto-assigned to `runbook-rotation`
- Sev1 (critical): sustained user impact (p99 >250ms AND error rate >10%) -> page infra + eng-incident lead + exec-oncall, PD escalation policy level2
Action on alert creation: auto-populate ticket with recent logs link, metrics snapshot link, and playbook link.
noah: OWNERS update plan: add `kv-ops` rotation group with 3 initial owners; ops-bot will post reminder 14 days before handoff and create a calendar block for quarterly audits.
ops-bot: INF-9010 updated: subtask INF-9010-1 (cheatsheet) -> sanjay; INF-9010-2 (staging validation) -> tess; INF-9010-3 (escalation matrix) -> evan; INF-9010-4 (owners rotation) -> noah. Links: https://tickets.redwood/INF-9010
sanjay: Minimal playbook PR opened: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/600 — cheatsheet + example outputs + rollback bullets. Keeping it lean for on-call readability.
tess: Staging validation notes: evict returned {"status":"ok","evicted":125}, metrics snapshot shows kv_cache_entries down ~13%, no 5xx spike in 10m. Added validation to the PR.
ev an: PagerDuty routing draft created and test alert executed; automation successfully created a test ticket tagged `runbook-rotation` and paged infra. I'll attach the routing config to INF-9010.
sanjay: PR merged: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/a1b2c3 — cheatsheet live. Marking INF-9010-1 done.
noah: OWNERS file updated and first 90-day rotation scheduled. Ops-bot reminder events created.
maya: Nice progress. Follow-ups: 1) leave the quarterly audit as a CRITICAL checklist item in the runbook, 2) ensure the auto-ticket template includes owner+ETA fields, 3) after 7 days of alert monitoring, we reconvene to surface any noise or gaps. If anyone needs more time, call it out. :thumbsup:
evan: Monitoring window started, will report in INF-9010 after 7d.
ops-bot: INF-9010 status: in-progress -> monitoring.
noah: Scheduling the first audit drill for 2026-05-12 and will post invites.
maya: Closing loop for this thread. Thanks all — please paste links to any supplementary docs into INF-9010 and tag `postmortem-followup`. :white_check_mark:
